name: debugger
description: Run LLVM-to-Scratch projects in TurboWarp and debug their source with LLDB.

mode.description: Debug with LLDB, or directly run in TurboWarp without starting LLDB.

project.description: Absolute path to the compiled SB3.

turbowarp.description: Optional TurboWarp Desktop executable for Run Without Debugging. Debug uses the browser interpreter.

turbowarpUrl.description: TurboWarp editor URL; no particular version is required.

node.description: Optional Node.js executable. Defaults to the VS Code host runtime.

lldbDap.description: Path to lldb-dap, or lldb-vscode on older installations.

clang.description: Clang used to assemble the virtual target's DWARF symbols. Defaults to toolchain.local.json or PATH.

lldbPython.description: Optional directory containing the Python runtime required by this LLDB build (Windows).

connectTimeout.description: Milliseconds allowed for TurboWarp and the local extension to connect.
